oneLiner: A tool for splitting shared trip expenses without a spreadsheet.
problem: Groups traveling together struggle to track who paid for what and calculate fair splits, leading to awkward conversations and disputes over money.
targetUser: Friends and groups planning trips or shared outings who want a simple, friction-free way to manage shared expenses.
coreFlow: Create a new trip and invite participants
Log expenses as they happen with payer and category
View settlement summary and payment instructions

screens.name: Trip Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of all active trips with balance summaries and quick access to add expenses

screens.name: Expense Entry
screens.purpose: Quick form to log a new expense with payer, amount, category, and who it applies to

screens.name: Settlement Summary
screens.purpose: Clear breakdown showing who owes whom and simplified payment paths to minimize transfers

screens.name: Trip Members
screens.purpose: View all participants and their individual balances in the trip

screens.name: Expense History
screens.purpose: Complete log of all expenses with filtering and editing capabilities

outOfScope: Integrated payment processing or money transfers
Social features like comments or messaging
